models.computational_cost: No runtime or complexity trace is given; graph construction, monthly event processing, Monte Carlo replication, multilayer statistics and coefficient sweeps remain under-specified.

details: The 100-month horizon, 18/25/35% churn, 14-worker multilayer example and coefficient ranges are paper-specific.

constraints: Preserve units, denominators, shortest paths, recursion signs, threshold ties, random seeds, edge refresh, layer coupling, and tolerance at every handoff.
